notes: Each photograph is used once. No alt is shown as text. Function words on the page: 'from' before a price marked from:true on an English page; control names are aria-labels.
The only words laid on a photograph are those of the first screen; its veil is set for a pure white picture (0.66 under the 14 px words, 0.5 under the giant figure, 0.72 more at the foot).
An accent that carries neither black nor white at 4.5:1 is deepened for the buttons; as 50 px type on the light ground it is deepened until 3.1:1.
needs (as written): one wide photograph for the first screen (>= 1400 wide, 1.3:1 or wider, not a portrait)
needs (as written): steps with their own pictures, or one person in team with a portrait
drops (as written): figures beyond the third
drops (as written): trust beyond the third
drops (as written): statement.title when it is a label rather than a sentence (kept as a hidden heading)
drops (as written): catalogue item and group pictures (the same pictures stand in the sequence)
drops (as written): project photographs beyond the first free one
drops (as written): photographs beyond the slots (person1: none; local1: 1 of 20, the group picture of the directors)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (media.made is never read)

picture_share_case: our page is at most 1.5 times the reference's height (person1 12025, local1 10899 against 11671), so the overall share is compared directly: reference 19 %, person1 17 %, local1 23 %; 2 screens with a wide picture in all three (first screen, the growing band)
